result.brief: 提出 G0.7 通用世界动作模型，将视频生成器扩展至五分钟长上下文并用大规模机器人遥操作与人类自我中心视频预训练，训练期视频预测塑造策略表征、部署时跳过未来帧生成以实现实时动作解码。
result.reason: Adapts pretrained video generators into a world action model with long context and large-scale robot/ego video pretraining; main contribution is robot policy, so it fits the secondary application direction.
